name: Spreadsheet editor
description: Edit Excel workbooks (.xlsx) inside Cairngorm. Saving rewrites only the cells you change.

operations.name: list-sheets
operations.description: List the workbook's worksheets and which one is shown.

operations.name: read-range
operations.description: Read cell values as shown (unsaved changes included) from a range such as A1:D20, at most 10,000 cells.

sheet.description: Worksheet name; the shown sheet when omitted

operations.name: set-cells
operations.description: Set cells like typing them: numbers, text, TRUE/FALSE, null to clear, or formulas starting with =. At most 1,000 cells; formulas are calculated when the file is opened in Excel.

cells.description: Map of cell reference to value, e.g. { "B2": 5, "C2": "=B2*2" }

sheet.description: Worksheet name; the shown sheet when omitted
